seed.one_line_summary: xsk: cache csum_start/csum_offset to fix TOCTOU in xsk_skb_metadata()
seed.vulnerability_summary: Userspace-mapped XSK TX metadata fields csum_start/csum_offset are read twice in xsk_skb_metadata(): once for bounds validation, once for skb assignment. Concurrent writes between reads bypass validation, causing out-of-bounds access during checksum computation.
seed.vulnerability_pattern: TOCTOU on shared memory: values read from user-writable memory for validation are re-read for use, allowing validation bypass via concurrent modification.
